summary: Climber suffered a significant fall (~15-ft tumbling fall while wearing helmet) at ~13,550 ft on the standard route of Maroon Peak, significant ankle injury, unable to walk; mutual-aid response for Gunnison County; 4 MRA members inserted by helicopter ~1 mi from subject and remained overnight; HAATS helicopter hoist evacuation at first light; subject transported to AVH by Aspen Ambulance; all out ~8:18 AM.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies; HAATS
notes: Date approximate: inferred Aug 8 from Aug 9 post describing overnight mission after 5:41 PM request.
